title: 1.7 What They Are Not Doing
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Use not to contrast what familiar people are doing with what they are not doing.
grammar_function: He/She is not + action; They are not + action.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.1-1.6: people, family roles, pronouns, is/are, and actions.
speaking_outcome: Say a positive action and a true negative contrast about the same scene.
